title: foundry project config
description: <repo>/.claude/foundry.json, read by foundry's skills and agents; the hooks don't read it. foundry init writes architecture and adr, and from 0.4.0 proposes roles, deploy, writingSkill and promptOverrides, writing them only after the owner approves (foundry ADR-0002). Every key but architecture and adr is optional and has a default. A reader reports each problem to the owner once and never treats one as fatal. It ignores a key this schema doesn't declare and unsets a value the schema rejects, so its default applies; inside roles and promptOverrides it unsets only the bad entry, and deploy fails closed: any error inside it, an undeclared key included, unsets the whole deploy key, and production is never defaulted to false. init keeps what the owner wrote, errors included, and reports them by path (foundry ADR-0002).

architecture.description: The architecture doc, relative to the repo root.

adr.description: The ADR directory, relative to the repo root.

agentCap.description: The most agents a plan may estimate. Default 40.

maxParallelCrews.description: The most crews running at once. Default 4.

merge.description: Merge mode of auto-started runs. Default sequential.

target.description: Target branch of auto-started runs. Default: the current branch.

roles.description: 0.4.0. Which agent type does each kind of crew work, by job, not by character. The foreman uses a listed type when the session can start it, and otherwise picks from its inventory as in 0.3.0. A job left out is picked from the inventory. The judge, cynic, lead and architect are always foundry's own and can't be mapped.

deploy.description: 0.4.0. How the project deploys, for the devops member's brief. A deploy to a target with production true always goes to the owner first, whatever else is configured.

writingSkill.description: 0.4.0. A skill the writer member loads with the Skill tool before it writes, such as technical-writer. Used only when the session lists it; otherwise the writer says so and carries on.

promptOverrides.description: 0.4.0. Per foundry role, a prompt file in the project whose instructions the role reads in addition to its own prompt. The brief names the file; it never replaces the role's prompt, and this file never holds prompt text (P21). The hooks' rules and each role's report format still hold.

agentType.description: A full agent type: a project or built-in type, or plugin:name.

promptFile.description: A markdown file directly under .claude/foundry/prompts/, relative to the repo root.
